about: Dulaglutide and sitagliptin are supplied on the same day to a person with documented type 2 diabetes.
Possible finding: neither the diabetes type nor the advised dulaglutide start date is recorded, so the same-day supplies do not settle whether dulaglutide and Nesina Met were used together.
Type 2 diabetes is confirmed. The 28-day sitagliptin course ends before dulaglutide is supplied on day 50.
